{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Now filter to treatment arm only
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response fraction
n_treatment = len(treatment_only)
n_responded = treatment_only['responded'].sum()
response_fraction = n_responded / n_treatment

# Print results
print(f"Number of unique patients in treatment arm after deduplication: {n_treatment}")
print(f"Number of responders in treatment arm: {n_responded}")
print(f"Response fraction: {response_fraction}")"}
